paragraphs: Assi. Yose bar Assi; Yaakov bar Assi; Abba bar Yisi; Rav Sama bar Rav Assi. [Glosses: (a) Niddah 2: Zeira asked Yose should read Assi, as new editions. (b) Yoma 24b: Rav Assi from Yochanan should be Rabbi Assi; Sanhedrin 50a too; reference error. (c) Pesachim 27, beginning of b: Rabbi Assi bar Chama should read Rami bar Chama, immediately named there; uncorrected in new editions; Ketubbot 48b too. (d) Megillah 22, end of a: distinguished priests Rav Ammi and Rav Assi should be Rabbi Ammi and Rabbi Assi; uncorrected. (e) Shabbat 50, beginning of a: Assi bar Shaul should be Yose; uncorrected. (f) Bava Batra 121, beginning of a: Yose bar Natan; Nedarim 78a: Assi bar Natan; Shabbat 53a: Assi; Haro'eh 62a: Issi. Undoubtedly one, but which is right requires examination; uncorrected. (g) Ketubbot 8a: Rav Assi visited Rav Assi’s house should read Rav Ashi, the early Ashi. (h) Bava Kamma 93a: The gloss proposes Rav Yosef bar Chama for Rav Assi bar Chama, citing Asheri. The checked Bavli has Rav Assi addressing Rava. Asheri has Rav Yosef addressing Rav. The gloss reports that its edition left the reading uncorrected.]
